summary.headline: FY26 consolidated EBITDA rose 44% to INR2,025 crores and PAT 58% to INR1,109 crores, with Q4 PAT up 53% YoY to INR155 crores.
summary.overview: Management reported record FY26 thermal (4,155 MU ex-captive, +84% YoY) and hydro (661 MU, +31%) generation, with the energy segment contributing about two-thirds of EBITDA. Consolidated revenue rose 23% to INR5,928 crores, and net debt fell to INR215 crores from INR1,566 crores. Q4 was dented by a 30 MW captive unit shutdown, a 300 MW turbine maintenance outage in January, seasonal hydro slowdown and the coal mine hitting its 1.8 MTPA approved limit. Management outlined a doubling of energy capacity to 1,200 MW by FY30 after the Supreme Court dismissed appeals on the SKS Power acquisition, plus a Raipur pellet expansion to 2 MTPA.

segments.name: Thermal power (ex captive)
segments.commentary: Generation reached a record 4,155 MU in FY26 versus 2,238 MU in FY25 (+84%), helped by SKS Power integration. Around 400 crore sellable units are guided for FY27 versus about 375 crore units sold in FY26; FY26 realisation was above INR5/unit.

segments.name: Hydropower
segments.commentary: Generation hit a record 661 MU in FY26 versus 508 MU in FY25 (+31%), helped by the 25 MW Rehar project. Management said the hydro segment EBITDA was about INR386 crores, and that two hydro projects have long-term PPAs.

segments.name: Steel, sponge iron and pellets
segments.commentary: Iron ore pellet output hit a record 826,293 MT and sponge iron 345,066 MT in FY26; HB wire record 40,425 MT. Steel realisation improved YoY and QoQ in Q4 but FY26 averaged below FY25.

segments.name: Coal mining (Gare Palma IV/7)
segments.commentary: FY26 output hit the 1.8 MTPA permissible limit after CECB consent for expansion from 1.68 MTPA; Q4 volumes were lower as the annual cap was exhausted. Domestic coal sales were about 150k MT, as most output is captively consumed.

guidance_outlook: SKS Power capacity to double to 1,200 MW by FY30; management now says commissioning is around 2030-31 because fresh environment clearance is being sought after the earlier one expired.
Acquisition of a majority stake in Adishankar Khuitam Power (66 MW, Arunachal Pradesh) approved; DPR being finalised, with the project expected to start by end-2026 and take 3-4 years.
Three small Chhattisgarh hydro projects (74 MW in total) may take 3-4 years to commission.
50 MW captive solar expected by end of Q1 FY27 (about September per later remarks); 30 MW TG set replacement to be back by end-June 2026.
Shahpur West high-grade coal mine targeted for commissioning before end-FY27; full-year operations expected in FY28.
Raipur pellet plant expansion from 0.9 to 2.0 MTPA, capex about INR500 crores, completion within 2.5 years; EC in place and DPR under preparation.

Annual hydro capex of about INR500-700 crores; the 600 MW IPP expansion to bring 'full blast' capex from next year, which will be substantially higher. Management did not give an investment figure for SKS expansion yet.
Management is evaluating separation of the renewable energy business (not the full power business); no conclusion yet.
Capex of about INR150 crores over the next two years at the Binjkot plant to improve PLF.
capex_capacity: Gare Palma IV/7 coal mine expansion to 1.8 MTPA with CECB consent; approvals for Gare Palma IV/5, Bartunga and Senduri coal mines progressing.
Binjkot (SKS) plant: over INR140 crores capex invested to date, with about INR150 crores more planned over the next two years to lift PLF.
Raipur pellet plant: 9 lakh tons to 20 lakh tons; about INR500 crores capex; 2.5-year build.
Mineral wool project installed to use industrial waste; management expects it to add to bottom line as it ramps up.
FY27 earnings drivers named: full-year Rehar hydro, efficiency gains at the IPP, 50 MW solar and the 30 MW TG set; FY28 driver is full-year Shahpur coal mine.
demand_pricing: Power exchange prices averaged INR3.75/unit in Q4 FY26, versus INR4.30 a year earlier and INR3.33 in Q3. Peak demand hit a record 270.8 GW.
Indian coal index rose 8% from March 2025 and 9% from December 2025 levels, due to import disruption from the West Asia conflict.

Steel prices recovered by about 10-15% in Q4 FY26 after reaching multi-year lows. Management expects long-product prices to rise once the conflict settles, but would not give Q1 FY27 realisation guidance.
Management said NMDC and OMC have cut iron ore prices, so end-product prices may fall.
India crude steel output grew over 11% in FY26; steel consumption about 164 million tonnes. Safeguard duties have reduced Chinese imports.

About 300 MW of the 600 MW IPP capacity is under PPA (medium/long term), with about 200 MW under PPA this year, rising to 300 MW next year. Management said PPA prices give more visibility than the volatile spot market.

qa_highlights.question: Why is the company restarting steel/pellet capex after holding back for a long time?
qa_highlights.answer: Management cited environment clearance and land/water already in place, and expected many Chhattisgarh iron ore mines to open within 2-2.5 years. The Raipur pellet expansion is designed to be ready when they do.

qa_highlights.question: Is there room to improve IPP efficiency and EBITDA per unit?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said there is scope to improve PLF at Binjkot, with about INR150 crores of capex planned over two years and spares and pending capex being completed.

qa_highlights.question: Will the company demerge steel and power?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said only the renewable energy business is being examined for separation, with no conclusion yet; the full power business is not part of it.

qa_highlights.question: When will the SKS 600 MW doubling be commissioned?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said commissioning is now expected around 2030-31 because fresh environment clearance is being obtained, as the earlier clearance had expired. Capex amount will be given after configuration is frozen.

qa_highlights.question: What is the FY27-FY28 capex and growth plan?
qa_highlights.answer: Annual hydro capex is about INR500-700 crores, with the 600 MW expansion adding substantially higher capex from next year. FY27 growth comes from efficiency, full-year Rehar, the IPP, solar and TG set; FY28 from full-year Shahpur mine.

qa_highlights.question: What were FY26 sellable units and realisation?
qa_highlights.answer: Previous-year sellable units were about 375 crore units and FY27 is guided to about 400 crore units. Average realisation was more than INR5 per unit.

qa_highlights.question: Why were Godawari Power shares bought in the open market?
qa_highlights.answer: Management called it normal treasury operations with no specific plans. Liquidity is about INR2,400 crores and the stake was about 1% of that.

risks_watch: West Asia conflict: the outcome affects steel, ferro alloy and coal prices, and demand. Management said a renewed war could weaken demand.
Timelines are slipping: SKS doubling is now 2030-31 and the 3 small hydro projects may take 3-4 years. The Chhattisgarh 74 MW and 66 MW Khuitam projects are at DPR and approval stages.
Coal mine output is capped at 1.8 MTPA, so Q4 showed weaker volumes; approvals for other mines are still pending.
Management did not disclose cost of generation or Q1 FY27 steel realisations, and did not give a capex figure for the SKS expansion yet.
Q4 disclosures were inconsistent on the domestic coal sales figure (150k MT) and on EBITDA definitions for the hydro segment.
summary.management_tone: Confident on the energy and mining growth story and the balance sheet, but cautious and sometimes evasive on near-term steel pricing, timelines and capex quantum, deferring several numbers to later disclosures.
key_quotes: Over FY21 to FY26, revenue has doubled at a CAGR of 21% to approximately INR5,928 crores.
The thermal power generation (ex captive) reached its highest ever level at 4,155 million units in FY26 as against 2,238 million units in FY25, representing a robust growth of 84% year -on-year.
We are exploring separation of the renewable energy business, not the complete power business.
It will be placed before the Board once we freeze the final capacity and the configuration, everything.
